nodes.label: Decision D2: .env.example is the push allowlist
nodes.rationale: A laptop .env accumulates scratch variables; requiring a committed line before a value reaches production makes deploying a new variable an explicit, reviewable act.

nodes.label: Decision D3: sensitivity read from `# secret` annotation
D3 revised: `# write-only` split, recoverability requirement
nodes.rationale: Vercel 'sensitive' storage is write-only on production, so annotating a key `# secret` also made it unrecoverable; splitting into `# secret` (Config, readable) vs `# write-only` (sensitive) makes env:pull able to rebuild a laptop .env from the remote alone.
